title: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty Triumph at China Masters
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a significant title, boosting their momentum for the upcoming Asian Games.
summary: India's star men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, clinched the China Masters title, attributing their success to strong defence and patient attack. This victory provides crucial momentum as they prepare to defend their Asian Games title.

title: BAI Announces Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course offers advanced training for Indian badminton coaches, enhancing the quality of coaching nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has scheduled a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, aimed at upgrading coaching standards.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: New regulations have been issued for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships, a key domestic event for Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining the rules and guidelines for participation in this important domestic tournament.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This notification concerns a change in the women's doubles pair for the Indian selection trials for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification has been issued regarding a change in the Women’s Doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, affecting India's junior team prospects.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on developing young talent.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, aiming to standardize play.
